Visioner BREAKING | 🇪🇪 🇺🇦 🇷🇺 ‼️ ‼️ Estonia’s Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna has arrived in Kyiv just one day after Russia warned that relations with Estonia were approaching open military conflict. Tsahkna posted a video from Kyiv’s Khreshchatyk street with the message “Good morning, Kyiv!” His visit follows accusations from Russia’s Foreign Ministry that Estonia is attempting to impose a naval blockade on Russia, allowing Ukrainian drones to use its airspace, and persecuting Russian-speaking residents. Moscow also warned that relations between the two countries were approaching the brink of direct military confrontation. The accusations against Estonia remain Russian government claims. The timing of Tsahkna’s visit sends a clear diplomatic message. Despite Moscow’s increasingly aggressive rhetoric, Estonia continues to demonstrate its support for Ukraine. Russia’s threats against a NATO member also raise concerns about further escalation in the Baltic region, where military provocations or miscalculations could have serious consequences for European security.
